answers.q1: Maven, run through the committed wrapper ./mvnw (Java 17+, no global Maven needed). Install/resolve dependencies with: ./mvnw dependency:go-offline (the Gradle alternative, also in the repo, is ./gradlew dependencies).
answers.q4: CI (.github/workflows/maven-build.yml) runs ./mvnw -B verify, which includes the format and lint checks. The check-only subset is ./mvnw -B validate, which runs spring-javaformat:validate (Spring Java format) and the nohttp-checkstyle check bound to the validate phase. The Gradle workflow runs ./gradlew build, which includes checkstyle and format checks.
answers.q5: Generated: src/main/resources/static/resources/css/petclinic.css is compiled from src/main/scss/*.scss by the libsass plugin under the css profile (regenerate with ./mvnw package -P css; edit the .scss, not the CSS). target/ and build/ are gitignored build output. Vendored: src/main/resources/static/resources/fonts/* (Montserrat and Varela Round webfonts) and gradle/wrapper/gradle-wrapper.jar (wrapper jar, do not hand-edit). Bootstrap and Font Awesome come from Maven webjars, not from files in the repo.

q1.reason: Uses the Maven wrapper ./mvnw with dependency resolution (dependency:go-offline is equivalent to dependency:resolve) and mentions the Gradle wrapper.

q3.reason: ./mvnw test -Dtest with the fully-qualified class name is explicitly accepted.

q4.reason: Identifies ./mvnw -B verify as the CI command and ./mvnw -B validate running spring-javaformat:validate and nohttp checkstyle, plus ./gradlew build for Gradle, matching the truth.

q5.reason: Names petclinic.css generated from scss with the correct regeneration command, plus target/ and build/; the extra vendored items are harmless.
